item.name: Old Sack
item.effect: Stores carried items.
item.capacityOrStat: 5 item capacity; 7 with Scavenger or Explorer sack bonus.
item.source: Starting item.
item.upgradeRoute: No direct upgrade listed; replace it with a higher-capacity sack from chests or the Pelt Trader.
item.requirement: None.
item.bestFor: Starter carrying before the first Good Sack route.

item.name: Good Sack
item.effect: Stores carried items with triple the Old Sack base capacity.
item.capacityOrStat: 15 item capacity; 17 with Scavenger or Explorer sack bonus.
item.source: Common Chests, Good Chests, Iron Chests, or Pelt Trader first trade.
item.upgradeRoute: No direct upgrade listed; replace it with Infernal Sack or Giant Sack later.
item.requirement: Chest drop or Pelt Trader first trade.
item.bestFor: Early looting, wood hauling, and first Pelt Trader priority.

item.name: Infernal Sack
item.effect: Stores items and cooks raw meat placed inside.
item.capacityOrStat: 20 item capacity; 22 with Scavenger or Explorer sack bonus.
item.source: Infernal Chests in the Volcanic Biome or Cultist King drop chance.
item.upgradeRoute: No direct upgrade listed; Giant Sack has more capacity but does not list the auto-cook effect.
item.requirement: Reach Volcanic Biome Infernal Chests or defeat Cultist King.
item.bestFor: Long trips where carried raw meat can become cooked food.
item.availability: Normal run; biome or boss gated

item.name: Giant Sack
item.effect: Stores the largest normal sack load.
item.capacityOrStat: 25 item capacity; 27 with Scavenger or Explorer sack bonus.
item.source: Legendary Chests, Gold Chests, or Pelt Trader third trade.
item.upgradeRoute: No direct upgrade listed.
item.requirement: Late chest source or Pelt Trader third trade.
item.bestFor: Large loot trips, late wood hauling, and fewer returns to camp.

item.name: Old Axe
item.effect: Cuts trees and damages entities.
item.capacityOrStat: 13 hits to chop a normal tree; 7 hits after Axe Trim Kit.
item.source: Starting item, except when Lumberjack replaces it with Good Axe.
item.upgradeRoute: Can be improved with Axe Trim Kit.
item.requirement: None.
item.bestFor: Starting wood collection before a Good Axe or better axe is found.

item.name: Good Axe
item.effect: Cuts trees, damages entities, and can break ice around Ice Chests.
item.capacityOrStat: 5 hits to chop a normal tree; about 5-7 hits for Ice Chest ice; 4 tree hits after Axe Trim Kit.
item.source: Pelt Trader first trade, Common Chests, Good Chests, or Lumberjack class.
item.upgradeRoute: Can be improved with Axe Trim Kit.
item.requirement: Chest source, Pelt Trader first trade, or Lumberjack class.
item.bestFor: Early wood speed and first ice-breaking utility.

item.name: Ice Axe
item.effect: Cuts trees, damages entities, slows hit entities, and breaks ice around cold chests.
item.capacityOrStat: 5 hits to chop a normal tree; about 5 hits for Ice Chest ice; cannot use Axe Trim Kit.
item.source: Cold Chests or Ice Chests in the Snow Biome.
item.upgradeRoute: Axe Trim Kit cannot be used on this axe.
item.requirement: Snow Biome cold or ice chest source.
item.bestFor: Snow Biome routing and slowing threats while chopping or escaping.

item.name: Strong Axe
item.effect: Cuts trees, big trees, and ice faster than earlier axes.
item.capacityOrStat: 1 hit for a normal tree; 35 hits for a big tree; 3 hits for Ice Chest ice; 33 big-tree hits after Axe Trim Kit.
item.source: Pelt Trader fourth trade, Legendary Chests, or Gold Chests.
item.upgradeRoute: Can be improved with Axe Trim Kit.
item.requirement: Late chest source or Pelt Trader fourth trade.
item.bestFor: Late wood routes, big trees, ice, and Hard Mode rift cleanup setup.

item.name: Chainsaw
item.effect: Cuts continuously while held and damages entities.
item.capacityOrStat: 2 ticks for a normal tree; 38 ticks for a big tree; 35 big-tree ticks after Axe Trim Kit.
item.source: Ruby Chests or Tool Workshop.
item.upgradeRoute: Can be improved with Axe Trim Kit.
item.requirement: Workshop craft uses Cultist Gems, Bear Pelts, Alpha Wolf Pelts, Bunny Feet, and Scrap; exact recipe belongs with Crafting.
item.bestFor: Continuous chopping and late-run tree clearing when a workshop or Ruby Chest route is available.
item.availability: Normal run; workshop or late chest gated

item.name: Old Rod
item.effect: Lets players fish from ponds for fish, resources, and other items.
item.capacityOrStat: Level 1 fishing rod.
item.source: Fishing Cabin or Fishing Hut, Tool Trader, chests, or Fisherman class.
item.upgradeRoute: Gain rod XP by successfully fishing, then upgrade at the Tool Trader workshop after the XP bar fills.
item.requirement: Find one from a fishing structure or chest, start as Fisherman, or buy from Tool Trader for 20 Mossy Coins.
item.bestFor: Starting the fishing route for food, scrap, ammo, bandages, and rare fishing rewards.

item.name: Good Rod
item.effect: Makes fishing easier than Old Rod.
item.capacityOrStat: Level 2 fishing rod.
item.source: Upgrade an Old Rod after filling rod XP.
item.upgradeRoute: Upgrade Old Rod at the Tool Trader workshop after the rod XP bar fills.
item.requirement: Old Rod with enough rod XP.
item.bestFor: Mid fishing after the first rod XP bar is finished.

item.name: Strong Rod
item.effect: Makes fishing easier than Good Rod.
item.capacityOrStat: Level 3 fishing rod; maximum rod level listed.
item.source: Upgrade a Good Rod after filling rod XP.
item.upgradeRoute: Final listed rod upgrade at the Tool Trader workshop after the rod XP bar fills.
item.requirement: Good Rod at max XP.
item.bestFor: Harder catches and longer fishing-focused routes.

item.name: Old Taming Flute
item.effect: Starts the animal taming minigame and shows nearby tamed animal hearts when held.
item.capacityOrStat: Can tame animals listed with 1-3 hearts or faces.
item.source: Abandoned Animal Shelter or Domestication Cabin, Tool Trader, Zookeeper class, and source-listed Pelt Trader second trade.
item.upgradeRoute: Gain flute XP through taming or healing tamed animals, then upgrade at the Tool Trader workshop.
item.requirement: Find one from the animal shelter/cabin route, start as Zookeeper, buy from Tool Trader for 20 Mossy Coins, or use the source-listed Pelt Trader route.
item.bestFor: Starting bunny, kiwi, frog, scorpion, or wolf taming routes.

item.name: Good Taming Flute
item.effect: Tames stronger animals than Old Taming Flute and shows nearby tamed animal hearts when held.
item.capacityOrStat: Can tame animals listed with 3-4 hearts or faces.
item.source: Upgrade an Old Taming Flute at the Tool Trader workshop.
item.upgradeRoute: Upgrade Old Taming Flute at the Tool Trader workshop after enough flute XP.
item.requirement: Old Taming Flute with enough flute XP.
item.bestFor: Mid taming routes such as Arctic Fox and Alpha Wolf.

item.name: Strong Taming Flute
item.effect: Tames the strongest listed animals and can raise pet capacity for most classes.
item.capacityOrStat: Can tame animals listed with 5 hearts or faces; increases pet capacity by 1 except for Zookeeper, Beastmaster, and Necromancer.
item.source: Upgrade a Good Taming Flute.
item.upgradeRoute: Final listed flute upgrade at the Tool Trader workshop after enough flute XP.
item.requirement: Good Taming Flute upgrade progress.
item.bestFor: Bear, Polar Bear, Mammoth, Mossy Mammoth, and Hellephant taming routes.

item.name: Old Flashlight
item.effect: Lights the night and can stun The Deer, The Owl, and The Ram.
item.capacityOrStat: Old Flashlight max charge is listed as 50%.
item.source: Chests, Pelt Trader first trade, or Watch Tower.
item.upgradeRoute: No direct upgrade listed; replace with Strong Flashlight.
item.requirement: Chest, Watch Tower, or Pelt Trader source.
item.bestFor: Basic night vision and emergency monster stuns.

item.name: Strong Flashlight
item.effect: Lights farther and stuns The Deer, The Owl, and The Ram longer than Old Flashlight.
item.capacityOrStat: Strong Flashlight max charge is listed as 100%.
item.source: Iron Chests, Legendary Chests, Gold Chests, or Pelt Trader third trade.
item.upgradeRoute: No direct upgrade listed.
item.requirement: Better chest source or Pelt Trader third trade.
item.bestFor: Night exploration, longer stun windows, and safer travel away from camp.

item.name: Hammer
item.effect: Moves structures and many decorations around camp.
item.capacityOrStat: Cannot move the Teleporter or defensive blueprints such as Barbed Wire and Stakes.
item.source: Tool Workshop, Decorator class, Blacksmith class, or Engineer class.
item.upgradeRoute: No upgrade listed.
item.requirement: Tool Workshop craft uses 5 Logs and 5 Scrap.
item.bestFor: Camp layout fixes, furniture moving, and decoration pickup.
item.availability: Normal run; class or workshop source

item.name: Paint Brush
item.effect: Repaints selected furniture at the campfire base.
item.capacityOrStat: 32 colors listed; most furniture cannot be painted except beanbags, cushions, and cloth frame.
item.source: Decorator class, side of the Horse carriage, and Decorator Gamepass source listed by the wiki.
item.upgradeRoute: No upgrade listed.
item.requirement: Class, Horse carriage, or listed gamepass source.
item.bestFor: Cosmetic base decoration rather than survival routing.

item.name: Map
item.effect: Shows the full map, important locations, and explored or unexplored areas.
item.capacityOrStat: Craftable max 1.
item.source: Crafting Bench Tier 1.
item.upgradeRoute: No upgrade listed.
item.requirement: 3 Wood.
item.bestFor: Early navigation and planning unexplored routes.

item.name: Sun Dial
item.effect: Shows how much time is left until day or night.
item.capacityOrStat: Timer appears in the top-right screen area after crafting.
item.source: Crafting Bench Tier 2.
item.upgradeRoute: No upgrade listed.
item.requirement: 5 Scrap.
item.bestFor: Leaving enough time to return to camp before night.

item.name: Compass
item.effect: Shows direction to the Fairy and missing children and shows where the player is facing.
item.capacityOrStat: Top-right screen utility after crafting.
item.source: Crafting Bench Tier 2.
item.upgradeRoute: No upgrade listed.
item.requirement: 3 Scrap.
item.bestFor: Rescue routing and objective direction checks.

item.name: Radar
item.effect: Detects key places in the forest by using Scrap.
item.capacityOrStat: Uses Scrap to detect key locations.
item.source: Crafting Bench Tier 3.
item.upgradeRoute: No upgrade listed.
item.requirement: 15 Wood and 10 Scrap.
item.bestFor: Finding important locations after basic map tools are built.

item.name: Lightning Rod
item.effect: Attracts lightning so it does not strike the player.
item.capacityOrStat: Can be placed more than once; Crafting tips say one is usually enough.
item.source: Crafting Bench Tier 3.
item.upgradeRoute: No upgrade listed.
item.requirement: 8 Scrap.
item.bestFor: Storm safety around base or routes where lightning is a risk.

item.name: Teleporter
item.effect: Allows teleporting across the map when two or more Teleporters are placed.
item.capacityOrStat: Requires two or more Teleporters to work; can be placed more than once.
item.source: Crafting Bench Tier 4.
item.upgradeRoute: No upgrade listed; Hammer source says Teleporter cannot be picked up with Hammer.
item.requirement: 15 Wood, 25 Scrap, and 1 Cultist Gem.
item.bestFor: Long-distance travel, rift cleanup, and returning between far objectives.

item.name: Respawn Capsule
item.effect: Automatically respawns the most recent dead player inside it after charging.
item.capacityOrStat: Must charge before the respawn effect triggers.
item.source: Crafting Bench Tier 5.
item.upgradeRoute: No upgrade listed.
item.requirement: 40 Wood, 40 Scrap, and 1 Gem of the Forest.
item.bestFor: Team recovery on long runs where a death would otherwise cost the route.

item.name: Temporal Accelerometer
item.effect: Skips the next night once charged.
item.capacityOrStat: Night-skip device; Days source calls it highly valuable for speedruns.
item.source: Crafting Bench Tier 5.
item.upgradeRoute: No upgrade listed.
item.requirement: 40 Wood, 40 Scrap, and 1 Gem of the Forest; Days source also notes a Cultist Gem cost per use.
item.bestFor: Speedruns and skipping dangerous nights after late crafting setup.

item.name: Corrupted Axe
item.effect: Hard Mode corrupted axe with Strong Axe-like tree-chopping utility and limited corruption meter use.
item.capacityOrStat: Equivalent to Strong Axe tree-chopping speed; explodes when its corruption meter reaches 100%.
item.source: Corrupted Chests during Hard Mode.
item.upgradeRoute: No upgrade listed; when used up it permanently increases map corruption by 10%.
item.requirement: Hard Mode corruption event and corrupted chest source.
item.bestFor: Temporary rift and corrupted-tree cleanup when a normal Strong Axe or Chainsaw route is not ready.

item.name: Admin Sack
item.effect: Admin-only sack with extreme carrying capacity.
item.capacityOrStat: 99,999 item capacity; Admin Items source says 100,001 with Scavenger.
item.source: Update Party/admin-spawned item.
item.upgradeRoute: No upgrade listed.
item.requirement: Admin or Update Party availability only.
item.bestFor: Reference only; not a normal progression target.

item.name: Admin Axe
item.effect: Admin-only axe that instantly kills many entities and can one-hit trees.
item.capacityOrStat: Admin Items source excludes Mega Cultists, Evil Bunnies, and Evil Carrots from instant kill.
item.source: Update Party/admin-spawned item.
item.upgradeRoute: No upgrade listed.
item.requirement: Admin or Update Party availability only.
item.bestFor: Reference only; not a normal chopping or combat goal.

item.name: Admin Flashlight
item.effect: Admin-only light that lasts infinitely, shines extremely bright, and burns entities it shines on.
item.capacityOrStat: Infinite duration listed by Admin Items source.
item.source: Update Party/admin-spawned item.
item.upgradeRoute: No upgrade listed.
item.requirement: Admin or Update Party availability only.
item.bestFor: Reference only; not a normal night-safety target.

item.name: Admin Taming Flute
item.effect: Admin-only flute that instantly tames animals.
item.capacityOrStat: Can tame a maximum of 200 animals instantly.
item.source: Update Party/admin-spawned item.
item.upgradeRoute: No upgrade listed.
item.requirement: Admin or Update Party availability only.
item.bestFor: Reference only; not a normal taming route.
